admission.justification: The static check and the real load are deliberately separate realizations, and the cases prove neither stands in for the other.

applicability: Every revision a seat stages for publication on the review page.
conditions: Readiness reads the staged bytes and the bound evidence packet.
The load runs the page in the isolated host with no model.
exclusions: A page that declares no parts, which readiness admits as one implicit whole-page part holding every claim.
statement: A revision becomes ready only after a static readiness check over its exact bytes — including a part-map check that refuses an inadmissible part id, a claim mark that is not a claim id of this revision, an unmapped claim and a claim whose basis does not resolve — and one real model-free load; a failed or unavailable load refuses publication and keeps the last ready revision.
